title.zh: Omnilock V1 约束（2022 年早期版本）

subtitle.zh: 来源：nervosnetwork/ckb-production-scripts@ddaeae8 c/omni_lock.c + c/ckb_identity.h（build.rs 固定的二进制 hash = 主网 V1 data hash 0xf18e…dee5）　·　mainnet 0xa439…086d / testnet 0x79f9…2e1e，hash_type type
subtitle.en: Source: nervosnetwork/ckb-production-scripts@ddaeae8 c/omni_lock.c + c/ckb_identity.h (binary hash pinned in build.rs = mainnet V1 data hash 0xf18e…dee5)　·　mainnet 0xa439…086d / testnet 0x79f9…2e1e, hash_type type

body.zh: Cell{ lock: 任意, type: 任意 }

role.zh: 0 CKB / 1 ETH / 6 multisig / 0xFC owner lock / 0xFD exec / 0xFE dl（V1：2 EOS / 3 Tron / 4 BTC / 5 Doge 虽有定义但 ckb_verify_identity 不处理 → 4；0x12 未定义）
role.en: 0 CKB / 1 ETH / 6 multisig / 0xFC owner lock / 0xFD exec / 0xFE dl (V1: 2 EOS / 3 Tron / 4 BTC / 5 Doge are defined but ckb_verify_identity does not handle them → 4; 0x12 undefined)

role.zh: pubkey hash / 地址 / multisig script hash / lock script hash[0..20]
role.en: pubkey hash / address / multisig script hash / lock script hash[0..20]

role.zh: bit0 管理员(omni_root) · bit1 ACP · bit2 time-lock · bit3 supply
role.en: bit0 admin (omni_root) · bit1 ACP · bit2 time-lock · bit3 supply

cond.zh: 长度 = 22 + 所选可选字段，多一字节少一字节都不行
只接受 0、1、6、0xFC、0xFD、0xFE；其余（含 2–5、0x12）返回 CKB_INVALID_DATA
cond.en: only 0, 1, 6, 0xFC, 0xFD, 0xFE are accepted; anything else (incl. 2–5, 0x12) returns CKB_INVALID_DATA

cond.zh: 恢复出的地址 = auth content

cond.en: multisig rules as in secp multisig

cond.zh: 某个 input 的 lock hash 前 20B = auth content
cond.en: some input lock hash[0..20] = auth content

cond.zh: 每个 group input 的 since flags 相同且 ≥ args.since
cond.en: each group input since has same flags and ≥ args.since

cond.zh: info cell 供应量不超上限、不得 burn 等
cond.en: info cell supply ≤ max, no burn, etc.

title.zh: ACP 模式（bit1 且无签名）

inputs.label: input

cond.zh: 每个输入 lock 必须有唯一对应输出
cond.en: each input lock pairs with exactly one output

cond.zh: CKB 与 UDT 均不减少，且增加不少于最小值
cond.en: CKB and UDT don't decrease and grow by at least the minimum

body.zh: RC cell（type_id = omni_root），含白名单 SMT root
body.en: RC cell (type_id = omni_root) with whitelist SMT root

body.zh: 任意；since / supply / ACP 均不生效
body.en: any; since / supply / ACP don't apply

cond.zh: 证明条数 = rule 数，identity 在白名单 SMT 中
cond.en: proof count = rule count, identity in whitelist SMT

notes.zh: 版本核验：主网 OMNI Lock V1（0xa439…086d）的 code cell 数据 blake2b = 0xf18e295b…dee5，这个值写在 ckb-production-scripts 的 build.rs 里（commit ddaeae8 “Omnilock (#21)”，2022-03-07 起，直到 716433e 改掉），build.rs 会在构建时校验产物 hash，因此可判定 V1 即该时期的 c/omni_lock.c。本页规则按 ddaeae8 阅读。
notes.en: Version check: the mainnet OMNI Lock V1 (0xa439…086d) code cell data hashes (blake2b) to 0xf18e295b…dee5. That value is pinned in ckb-production-scripts build.rs from commit ddaeae8 "Omnilock (#21)" (2022-03-07) until 716433e changed it; build.rs checks build outputs against it, so V1 is c/omni_lock.c of that period. These rules were read at ddaeae8.

notes.zh: 测试网 OMNI Lock V1（0x79f9…2e1e）的二进制 data hash 是 0x1bf147d1…67d1，与主网 V1 不同，未在 ckb-production-scripts / omnilock 历史中找到对应 commit；规则未针对该二进制核验。
notes.en: The testnet OMNI Lock V1 (0x79f9…2e1e) binary has data hash 0x1bf147d1…67d1, different from mainnet V1, and no matching commit was found in ckb-production-scripts / omnilock history; the rules are not verified for that binary.

notes.zh: 同一个 0x1bf147d1 二进制也部署在主网 0x9f3a…f52f（CKB Explorer 叫它 “Force Bridge”）：据 Explorer 公开 issue Magickbase/ckb-explorer-public-issues#532，它是 Force Bridge / Yokai Swap 在 Omnilock 主网发布前从未发布源码部署的 Omnilock。本插件也匹配它，但规则同样未核验。
notes.en: The same 0x1bf147d1 binary is deployed on mainnet as 0x9f3a…f52f (CKB Explorer calls it "Force Bridge"): per the Explorer public issue Magickbase/ckb-explorer-public-issues#532 it is an Omnilock that Force Bridge / Yokai Swap deployed from unreleased source before Omnilock launched on mainnet. This plugin matches it too, with the rules likewise unverified.

notes.zh: 与 V2（omnilock 页）的差异：V1 不支持 auth flag 2–5 与 0x12；time-lock 只把绝对 epoch 分数 flag（0x20）按 epoch 比较（V2 还处理相对 epoch 0xA0）；其余错误码与 V2 相同。
notes.en: Differences from V2 (omnilock page): V1 does not support auth flags 2–5 or 0x12; time-lock compares as epoch only for the absolute-epoch flag (0x20) (V2 also handles relative epoch 0xA0); other error codes are the same as V2.

notes.zh: 错误码：80 UNKNOWN_FLAGS · 81 PROOF_LENGTH_MISMATCHED · 82 NO_OMNIRULE · 83 NO_WHITE_LIST · 84 INVALID_IDENTITY_ID · 85 INVALID_OMNI_LOCK_ARGS · 86 ISO9796_2_VERIFY · 87 ARGS_FORMAT；70–75 identity 错误（70 LOCK_SCRIPT_HASH_NOT_FOUND, 71 WRONG_ARGS）；40–63 来自 rce.h
notes.en: Error codes: 80 UNKNOWN_FLAGS · 81 PROOF_LENGTH_MISMATCHED · 82 NO_OMNIRULE · 83 NO_WHITE_LIST · 84 INVALID_IDENTITY_ID · 85 INVALID_OMNI_LOCK_ARGS · 86 ISO9796_2_VERIFY · 87 ARGS_FORMAT; 70–75 identity errors (70 LOCK_SCRIPT_HASH_NOT_FOUND, 71 WRONG_ARGS); 40–63 from rce.h

notes.zh: 签名消息与 secp256k1_blake160 相同（sighash_all），ETH/BTC 等再按各链格式包装
notes.en: Signing message is the same sighash_all as secp256k1_blake160, then wrapped per chain format for ETH/BTC/etc.

notes.zh: witness 缺失不会立即失败（owner lock 模式可不需要 witness）
notes.en: A missing witness doesn't fail immediately (owner-lock mode may need none)
